mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 months signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 5% over 3 months and the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO > 1% MoM and the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth over 1 quarter
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth over 1 quarter and the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases & UNRATE decreases and the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST remains high and the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of instances.
